purpose: Research-only UAE official source pack candidates. This file does not activate monitoring and must not be marketed as validated coverage.

current_customer_truth.customer_copy: 13 enabled UAE sources; 9 readiness-supported; 4 under extraction remediation.

status_definitions.candidate: Official or officially linked candidate, not yet tested.
status_definitions.no_save_tested: Tested in Source Lab without evidence write.
status_definitions.readiness_supported: No-save extraction passed strict quality checks, but evidence/baseline may still be pending.
status_definitions.remediation: Useful source, but selector/parser/source model needs work.
status_definitions.blocked: Public monitoring is blocked or unsafe because of login, CAPTCHA, paywall, private portal, or access policy.
status_definitions.rejected: Not official, not UAE-relevant, duplicate, wrong-country, or otherwise not suitable.
